Name: JP's Girls of the Valley (Female Bachelors - Gender Bender Swap)
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][center][color=#ff00ff][u]The Girls of the Valley[/u][/color][/center][/size][/i][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][b][color=#00ffff][u]I used the [/u][/color][color=#00ffff][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/474]Adarin Mod[/url]﻿ as a base for the girls' sprites[/u][/color]. Unlike Adarin, who chose to create new characters by practically changing the color of the skin, eyes and clothes of the characters, I chose to keep as much as possible the appearance of the girls with respect to their male version, including their clothing. I tried to give unique personalities to the characters with their appearance without losing the way they usually are, with small changes in clothing when everything else failed. Shane is the only character that Adarin didn't make, so I took a lot of liberties with his design. [/b][/size]
[/list][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5][u]
Content:[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]This mod replaces the 6 bachelors in the game with girls, each of whom share obvious similarities with their male counterparts. It includes all the Sprites to date and also includes the beach Sprites. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]The mod [color=#ffff00]does not have PORTRAITS[/color] of the characters, I am not that skilled for that, instead I created anime portraits [color=#ffff00]using AI[/color] and modifying them with Paint.net. The download will be separated for those who don't like it, I won't do anything more about it for this part.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Several dialogues were changed to reflect the change of gender of the characters. You can also rename them as you wish from the mod settings, this will be reflected in any conversation that uses these names. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][size=4]
[/size][b][size=5][color=#ff00ff][u]Facts & Curiosities: "Name (Original name / [/u][/color][color=#ff00ff][u]Height in pixels)"[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][b]Alexis[/b] (Alex / 26px): A girl with a very masculine and confident manner. She likes sports and her hair, and also her hair. In short it can be said that she is a Tomboy with a little feminine charm, strong strong strong.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][b]Ellie[/b] (Elliott / 27px): With a calm and youthful appearance, you would be very surprised if she got angry. You wouldn't dare, would you?[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][b]Harley[/b] (Harvey / 26px): She has a lot on her head, plus hair that makes her look taller than she really is. Some say she is prettier with glasses and others say she is prettier without. I am blind. [/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][b]Samy[/b] (Sam / 26px): I don't know where this girl gets so much energy from! It is said that when she runs out of energy she doesn't even bother to cut her hair and it grows until you can't see her eyes. [color=#ffff00][b]No one can confirm this.[/b][/color] [/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][b]Sebastienne[/b] (Sebastian / 24px): She is the smallest of the village (in height), is that why she always looks at you ugly? can she see you behind that tuft of hair she wears?[/size]
[/list][size=4]- [b][color=#00ff00]The first of two characters that I had fun with her design, she is small compared to everyone else and gives a great contrast when you see her in the game. I think I should add a little bench to give her a kiss, or maybe you prefer to kiss her forehead? hahaha.[/color][/b]

[/size][list]
[*][size=4][b]Shannon[/b] (Shane / 32px): She really is tall. She always has a very tired and unfriendly face, she should take it easy. She let her hair grow too long...[/size]
[/list][size=4]- [b][color=#00ff00]The second character I let myself get carried away with, is the tallest girl, not being taller because the sprite panel doesn't allow her to be taller. Ridiculously long hair and a completely scary aura when you see her in the game, she's taller than your character!!!! 

[/color][/b][b][i][color=#00ffff]I wonder who will need that bench now...[/color][/i][/b][/size][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5][u]

Required Mods: [/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]: Needed to see the descriptions of what each option of my mod does. ﻿[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size]
[/font][font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ffff][size=5]If any artist wants to create their own portraits of these characters is more than welcome to do it, if you like you can let me know when you do it, I like to know about these things!
[/size][/color][/i][/b][/font][font=Georgia]
[color=#ff00ff][size=6][i][u]Translations:[/u][/i][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][size=4][color=#f4f4f4][/color]If you want, you can make the translation of this mod, [color=#ff0000]no need to ask for permission[/color], and you can publish it on your own in Nexus. [color=#ffff00]This is best because I won't be available to update the translations if you send it to me.[/color] [color=#f4f4f4][/color][/size]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]I will not do the usual translations into Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese either, so you are more than welcome to do translations into these languages. [/size][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]If you like you can let me know when you have published your translations so that I know you are there.[/size][size=3] [/size][/color]
[*][b][color=#00ffff][size=4]In addition to the dialogues modified by me, all languages that differentiate male and female in their words must add extra lines to have a correct dialogue.[/size][/color][/b]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=5]Thank you![/size][/color]
[/list]

[/font][font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][color=#ff0000]Any bugs or problems you encounter please report them as soon as possible with as much detail as you can provide. Do not report "[/color][color=#ffff00]There is a bug in the animation of x character[/color][color=#ff0000]"
and then go away for 10 years. [/color][/i][/b][/size][/font]

Downloads.Description: Unzip and install like any other mod. If you like the mod don't forget to hit the 'Endorse' button at the top of this page, it helps me a lot and it's free :D
